summary: Noether Paper 16 R121 local candidate directory. It appears to carry a R120-based German cumulative TeX/PDF candidate plus IA Math. Ann. 81 source leaves for printed pp.25-30. It is not a packaged, checksummed, source-ledgered, or reconciled Zenodo upload.
relationship_to_existing_pending: Supersession is not established. Existing pending P16 entries remain 20260613_noether_p16_source_audit_webdrop.json and 20260614_noether_p16_ra53_sourcecritical_candidate.json.

Those older entries package the targeted F-versus-Phi repair with README/PDF/log/checksum evidence. This R121 folder may be a later R120-based candidate, but needs packaging and verification before it can replace or supersede RA53.
limitations: No README, checksum manifest, baseline diff, source map, render check, or audit ledger was present in the local directory at sweep time; compile evidence exists but packaging and reconciliation do not.
German cumulative candidate only; no English/Spanish/Japanese/French/Chinese/Ukrainian/Russian/Interslavic propagation.
Not full Paper 16 source certification, not whole-corpus certification, and not a critical edition.
Needs a clean compile/render check and reconciliation against R120/R121 plus older RA53 before any upload or promotion.
recommended_next_action: Package only after producing README, checksums, source map, render check, baseline diff, audit ledger, and explicit relationship to RA53/R120/R121. Until then keep as local candidate evidence.
github_note: Corrections and source comparisons can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
build_observation: Local XeLaTeX log writes a 457-page PDF and the quick warning scan found inputenc/font substitution warnings only; no Fatal, Emergency stop, Undefined control, Missing character, Overfull, Underfull, or Error lines were found. This is compile evidence only, not a render/source audit.
